title: Siege of Kars (1744)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Kars (1744)", at revision 1377371946, opens: "The siege of Kars took place in 1744 during the Ottoman–Persian War of 1743–1746. Nader Shah, ruler of Persia, laid siege to the city of Kars on 29 July 1744. The siege was unsuccessful and the Persians retreated on 9 October." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q119167840, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege during the Ottoman–Persian War of 1743–1746". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
